race.title: Floodlit Fridays At Dundalk (Q.R.) Handicap
race.verdict: GRANVILLE STREET continues in fine form and can resume winning ways back on polytrack for the first time since his 3-y-o days when he ran well twice here. Ozark Daze is interesting from a career-low mark, with Letiza another to consider. GRANVILLE STREET (IRE) OZARK DAZE LETIZA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Letiza (3/1), Granville Street (7/2), Wandering Rocks (6/1), Ozark Daze (6/1), The Mediator (7/1), Friary Road (7/1), Palmezzano (10/1), Eskimo Komet (12/1), Big Dispute (25/1), Western Bandit (25/1), Chain Of Destiny (66/1)
